review_notes.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter（Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero 混搭）
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros（火山石锅杂烩，pork chop/chorizo/牛排/虾一锅）
review_notes.tips: 4点左右去不用排太久；牛舌taco炖得软嫩，喜欢牛舌的可以点；一定要挤 lime。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹的墨西哥街头风小馆，conceptual for group sharing

highlights: Authentic North York Mexican spot with generous, street-style portions
Sizzling molcajete stone platters and loaded taco platters built for sharing
options.description_zh: 北约克高人气墨西哥馆，主打街头风Taco拼盘与滋滋作响的Molcajete火山石锅，够朋友聚餐点一桌。
highlights_zh: 北约克地道墨西哥菜馆，肉给得很大方，街头风
招牌火山石锅Molcajete与Taco拼盘，适合多人分享
options.signature_dish_zh: Molcajete 火山石锅杂烩

review_notes_en.summary: Popular North York taqueria with street-style vibes, meat-heavy taco platters and a showpiece sizzling molcajete.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter (Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero mix)
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros (volcanic stone platter with pork chop, chorizo, steak and shrimp)
review_notes_en.tips: Go around 4pm to dodge the line; the lengua (beef tongue) taco is tender and worth trying; finish with lime.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, street-style Mexican taqueria perfect for group meals

options.name: Good Luck HK Cafe
options.signature_dish: Char-Grilled Mixed Meat Rice (Oily Rush over Rice)
options.description: North York Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro-red plates, Michelin-designed dinner set and smoky grilled meat rice bowls.
options.address: 5533 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 7L3

options.bullet_highlight: Retro cha chaan teng vibe with a Michelin-inspired dinner set menu

review_notes.summary: 北约克的茶餐厅，号称晚餐菜单请米其林厨师设计，红色复古餐具氛围感满分，烧腊饭与海鲜炖饭都惊喜。
review_notes.must_try:
🍚 黯然销魂烧腊饭（各式烧腊肉铺满，锅巴米饭绝了）
🦐 潮式海鲜炖饭（海鲜香奶香的潮式 risotto）
review_notes.tips: 晚餐有茶餐厅常规菜单加特别套餐，选择多；烟熏烤串、生腌泰式扇贝也不错；人均约35刀。
review_notes.vibe: 复古红色餐盘茶餐厅，晚餐氛围感十足，适合漂亮饭

highlights: Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro red plates and Michelin-designed dinner set
Char-grilled meat rice bowls and smoky skewers are the signature comfort hits
options.description_zh: 北约克人气港式茶餐厅，主打复古红盘氛围与请米其林厨师设计的晚餐特别菜单，黯然销魂烧腊饭与潮式海鲜炖饭是招牌。
highlights_zh: 港式茶餐厅，红盘复古美学，晚餐菜单据说请米其林厨师设计
招牌黯然销魂烧腊饭与烟熏烤串，是北约克的漂亮饭晚餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 黯然销魂烧腊饭

review_notes_en.summary: Trendy North York cha chaan teng with retro-red dishware, a Michelin-designed dinner set and crowd-pleasing char-grilled rice bowls.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍚 Signature Char-Grilled Mixed-Meat Rice (layers of roast meats with crispy rice crust)
🦐 Chaoshan-Style Seafood Risotto (savory seafood-scented rice casserole)
review_notes_en.tips: Dinner offers both a standard cha chaan teng menu and a special set menu; smoky skewers and Thai-style marinated scallops are also great. Expect roughly $35 per person with tax and tip.
review_notes_en.vibe: Retro HK diner atmosphere with red plates, ideal for a cozy date-night dinner

options.name: Pears Restaurant

review_notes.must_try:
🍔 Sliders（甜辣韩式炸鸡迷你堡）
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara（乌冬+麻辣奶油+温泉蛋）
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie（千层酥皮芋泥麻薯派）
review_notes.tips: 人很多但不吵不挤，动静好；热门cocktail如Zavatar（烟熏泡泡）、Plum Seika点燃火焰出品很有仪式感。
review_notes.vibe: 简约高级感的绿植餐厅，夜晚灯光氛围适合date night

highlights: Buzzy Markham brasserie by Chef Keith Pears with inventive Asian-fusion plates
Mala cream udon, taro mochi pie and theatrical cocktails set the mood
options.description_zh: 万锦人气融合餐厅，主厨Keith Pears 打造，绿植空间氛围感好，招牌菜包括麻辣奶油乌冬、芋泥麻薯派与主题鸡尾酒。
highlights_zh: 万锦约会首选融合菜馆，简约高级感绿植空间
麻辣奶油乌冬、韩式炸鸡slider与芋泥麻薯派人气出圈
options.signature_dish_zh: 麻辣奶油乌冬与芋泥麻薯派

review_notes_en.summary: Locally beloved Markham fusion restaurant with sleek plant-filled interiors, inventive small plates and showy cocktails.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍔 Sliders (sweet-spicy Korean fried chicken sliders)
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara (udon, spicy cream sauce, onsen egg)
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie (taro-mochi filled mille-feuille pastry)
review_notes_en.tips: Busy but never cramped; order one of the signature cocktails like Zavatar (smoky bubble) or Plum Seika (flamed) for full theatre.
review_notes_en.vibe: Slick, green-accented date-night dining room with buzzy but relaxed energy

review_notes.tips: 人均20刀出头能吃很好；羊排入味，推荐直接点lamb rice试水。
review_notes.vibe: 温馨平价的索马里馆子，适合一两个人慢慢吃

🍚 Fragrant Somali spice rice

🥟 Handmade Jumbo Mandu
🍜 Beef Kalguksu
🍲 Fiery Seafood Jjamppong
review_notes_en.tips: Look out for the lunch special deals; ample parking in the plaza; dine-in and takeout both easy.

🥩 Veal sandwich

options.signature_dish: Sichuan Water-Boiled Beef (水煮牛肉) & Red Oil Ear Slices

review_notes.summary: 列治文山的川菜+烧烤馆，白切+水煮牛肉+红油耳丝，是我吃过多伦多最接近重庆味道的川菜馆，N刷不腻。
review_notes.must_try:
🌶️ 水煮牛肉
🍆 口水茄子
👂 红油耳丝
review_notes.tips: 宫保鸡丁和鱼香肉丝是all time fav；酸菜鱼真的嫩，吃过别忘去；烧烤和川菜都点，不要只点一个。
review_notes.vibe: 正宗的重庆风川菜馆，适合多人小聚

highlights: Richmond Hill川菜馆，水煮牛肉+红油耳丝必点，是多伦多最接近重庆味道的川菜
口水茄子、酸菜鱼、宫保鸡丁都是经典，烧烤也同样在线

highlights_zh: 列治文山川菜+烧烤，口水茄子+红油耳丝是顶流
水煮牛肉正宗麻味突出，是多伦多忘不掉的川菜白月光

review_notes_en.must_try:
🌶️ Water-Boiled Beef
🍆 Spicy Mashed Aubergine
👂 Red Oil Ear Slices
review_notes_en.tips: 宫保鸡丁和鱼香肉丝 are all-time favorites; both川菜和烧烤一锅也值得。
review_notes_en.vibe: Authentic Chongqing-style Sichuan eatery, great for groups

options.name: Hong Kong Bistro Cafe
options.signature_dish: Hainan Chicken Rice & Butter-Roasted Garlic Frankling Escargot
options.description: Hidden-gem港式茶餐厅 on Dundas St W, famous for $12.95 lunch sets, hand-pulled milk tea and affordable HK rice dishes.
options.address: 472 Dundas St W, 2nd Floor, Toronto, ON M5T 1G9
options.bullet_flavor: $12.95 HK lunch sets, hand-pulled milk tea and affordable HK rice dishes
options.bullet_highlight: DT Chinatown港式茶餐厅，手拉红茶+少Sugar+大份套餐才$12.95

review_notes.summary: 唐人街里宝藏港式茶餐厅，每天手写白板写着当日specials套餐，一份才$12.95，含自选饮料、例汤和大份饭/面。
review_notes.must_try:
🐔 海南鸡饭
🍛 葡国鸡饭
🍔 炸大鸡腿煎蛋饭
review_notes.tips: 白板上的当日specials多留意：盖饭最好别搭盖饭拼盘，其他都不踩雷；手拉红茶记得要少糖；适合$15香港味道 lunch。
review_notes.vibe: 港式茶餐厅，赶着上班的本地客和旁人都有，B-class 便宜大碗

highlights: Hidden-gem港式茶餐厅 on Dundas with a handwritten daily-specials board
$12.95 lunch set includes drink, soup and a big rice or noodle main, hand-pulled milk tea by the boss
options.name_zh: 新香港餐廳 Hong Kong Bistro Cafe

highlights_zh: DT唐人街宝藏港式茶餐厅，午市套餐才$12.95
手拉红茶+海南鸡饭+焗蜗牛，都是必点

options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A local-favourite港式茶餐厅 hidden on Dundas, with daily-specials handwritten on a board, $12.95 lunch sets and boss-pulled milk tea.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐔 Hainan chicken rice
🍛 Portuguese chicken rice
🐌 Butter garlic escargot
review_notes_en.tips: Grab the handwritten daily specials; hand-pulled milk tea is best less-sweet; skips the rice-platter combos if you want reliable hits.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, old-school Hong Kong cafe/casual eatery in the heart of Chinatown

options.bullet_flavor: 重庆street-style hot pot with beef tallow mala broth,川味小腊肠 and rocket squid
options.bullet_highlight: All-you-can-eat hot pot at 3225 Hwy 7 in Markham, rare川渝 street-style menu

review_notes.summary: 万锦Hwy7的火锅自助，牛油麻辣锅+花胶鸡鸳鸯锅，价格周末$36.99，食材丰富且自由酸梅汤。
review_notes.must_try:
🐮 牛油麻辣锅
🐓 花胶鸡锅
🦑 火箭鱿鱼 / 鸭肠 / 耗儿鱼
review_notes.tips: 汤底需额外付费；信用卡结账有2.4%手续费，建议用Debit Card或现金；菜单有多伦多罕见川味小件
review_notes.vibe: 重庆街头风味的火锅馆，适合几个人一起吃

highlights: 重庆街头风味的火锅自助，主打牛油麻辣锅和花胶鸡鸳鸯锅
鸭肠、火箭鱿鱼、耗儿鱼等多伦多少见的川味食材

review_notes_en.summary: All-you-can-eat Chongqing-style hot pot in Markham with beef tallow mala broth, a two-broth combo and rare川味 mix-ins.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐮 Beef Tallow Spicy Broth
🐓 Chicken-Mushroom Broth
🦑 Rocket Squid / Duck Intestine / Fatty Fish
review_notes_en.tips: Soup bases cost extra; credit card charged 2.4%, bring debit or cash. Three rare items are duck intestine, rocket squid and fatty fish.
review_notes_en.vibe: Street-style Chongqing hot pot, go with friends

options.description: Scarborough Shunde-style congee hot pot near Midland, blending广东congee broth with鲜鲍、五花趾 and 烤乳鸽, open till 3am.

options.bullet_flavor: Creamy Shunde-style congee broth with鲜鲍鱼,五花趾 and char-roasted pigeon
options.bullet_highlight: Scarborough顺德-style congee hot pot with鲜鲍五花趾 and char-roasted pigeon

review_notes.must_try:
🥩 手切吊龙
🦪 鲜鲍鱼
🍖 五花趾
🐦 烤乳鸽
review_notes.tips: 锅底可自己加盐和胡椒；高峰期要排队一小会；店里是广东茶楼风松弛，朋友聚餐带长辈都行
review_notes.vibe: 顺德茶楼style，毋米粥锅底，适合夏天清爽吃

highlights: 顺德style congee hot pot with鲜鲍鱼,五花趾 and a creamy porridge base
Hand-sliced beef, roasted pigeon and a Guangzhou tea-house atmosphere

🥩 Hand-Sliced Beef
🦪 Fresh Abalone
🍖 Five-Toe Meat
🐦 Roast Pigeon
